headline: Why do businesses find it difficult to access international green capital?
summary: International investors have ample funds for the green transition, but experts say projects in Vietnam are not yet attractive enough. Businesses find access to international green capital difficult.
why: Green finance flows determine how energy transition projects are funded, affecting renewable energy developers, banks and long-term infrastructure investment.
